applicability.hardware: any; CUDA examples from sources, NPU adaptation required
applicability.prerequisites: profiler access (nsys/ncu or NPU equivalent), or willingness to work at L1 analytical only

limitations: Source-derived candidate; no local efficacy validation.
Acceptance-target preparation is agent guidance: the CLI and pure L1 helper do not infer gates, and unsupported estimates cannot replace user criteria or qualify campaign outcomes.
Mooncake's prefix-reuse condition is an analytical approximation; current cache validity, placement, effective rates, overlap and SLO outcomes remain unverified.

FlexGen's cross-tier feasibility comparison assumes fitted rates and perfect overlap; relaxed placements may OOM, the printed bls wording remains unresolved, and current compatibility, latency and efficacy are unverified.

The HuggingArch checkpoint anchor covers stored weights only. KV size and growth, activation traffic, collectives and end-to-end serving performance stay unanchored by it. Per-rank weight bytes stay unanchored until the second gate passes, and that gate checks the declared layout and format, not the placement a framework uses at run time.
Checkout-only local skill; no automatic execution or promotion.
Only declared references are required; other cross-skill links are navigation.
Historical revisions require a matching checkout or a retained store.
